available_enums.name: variant
available_enums.description: used for changing the font sizes

components.title: Scenes
components.description: standalone, no siblings

components.name: AnimatedNumber
components.description: Counting metric with label text. Make sure there is no other number in the label. Use for stats and KPIs

components.name: StatCounter
components.description: Centered animated metric counter with a short 2-3 word label below it. Use for large number, single stat, metric, or KPI with or without prefix/suffix eg. 1240, 500$, 500K, 500M

components.name: TextStagger
components.description: Reveals a word or full text phrase word-by-word. Works for both single word and multi-word headlines or body text.

components.name: TitleSplit

llmSchema.name: topText
llmSchema.hint: Start of a short, high-impact phrase. Keep it concise and clear. Example: "AI WILL EDIT", "CREATE FAST", "STOP WASTING"

llmSchema.name: bottomText
llmSchema.hint: Continuation of the phrase with topText to complete the idea. Example: "YOUR VIDEOS", "IN SECONDS", "TIME TODAY"

components.description:
Use this component for short, high-impact phrases that need strong emphasis, like intros, key statements, or transitions. 
Works best when both lines combine into one clear idea and the wording is concise, not conversational.

components.name: TextHookStagger
components.description: Reveals a short hook or intro phrase word-by-word. Best for 4-5 word hook/intro scenes.

components.name: Typewriter
components.description: Character-by-character text reveal. Use for dramatic reveals or code/terminal effects.

components.name: TextHighlight
components.description: Bold statement with an emphasized word/phrase. Use for key claims. Use {} to highlight. eg "We build amazing {software}"

components.name: WordCycle
components.description: Rotates through words on a bold background. Use for emphasis words, or highlighting multiple key points.

components.name: TextWithWordCycle
components.description: Static text with cycling highlighted words at the end. Use for dynamic taglines like "We build amazing [software/products/solutions]"

components.name: TextLeadStagger
components.celExpression: ((50 + max(0, segmentCount(props.textleadstagger.text, "word") - 2) * 5 + max(0, segmentCount(props.textleadstagger.text, "word") - 1) * 4) * 100) / max(25, props.textleadstagger.speed)
components.description:
First word starts enlarged and then settles down. The remaining words enter in a stagger, making it ideal for emphasis moments (MAX 3–4 words).
Examples:
text="Isn't getting clicks"
text="You're missing out"

You can combine it with other **fillers scenes** for showcasing a **"Problem" or "Solution" section** of a video or use it as a standalone filler with other scenes.

Example problem: "If your Airbnb listing isn't getting clicks"

- Scene 1: If (TextStagger)
- Scene 2: your (TextStagger)
- Scene 3: Airbnb {listing} (TextHighlight)
- Scene 4: isn't getting clicks (TextLeadStagger)

components.name: ProblemHeadline
components.description: A short headline scene for concise text. Use it to show the main problem, key pain point, or an important headline from the script. Best for 2-6 words

components.name: TextCardStack
components.description: Displays problem or solution statements as playful stacked cards. Best for short descriptive phrases; avoid very brief (one- or two-word) content.

components.name: TextWithImageScene
components.description: Displays text with an image. Choose one of the filler component and its props in textComponentProps: texthighlight, textstagger, or textwithwordcycle.

components.name: TextWithVideoScene
components.description: Displays text with a video. Choose one of the filler component and its props in textComponentProps: texthighlight, textstagger, or textwithwordcycle.

components.name: MultiImageStack

llmSchema.name: cyclingWords
llmSchema.hint: The features to highlight per image

llmSchema.name: images
llmSchema.hint: The images of each feature under a usecase

components.description:
A centered TextWithWordCycle headline above a stacked images revealing one by one with word cycle. 
    use it to show multi features of a usecase with product images
    Takes around 170 frames for 3 images.

components.name: ProblemCollage
components.description:
Centered problem statement with screenshots that fly in around it as a scattered collage. Best used to show data scattered across tools, fragmentation, multiple issues kind of problems.
Provide 5 default images of size 800x400 that user can change later
Takes around **66 frames** to complete

components.name: LogoShowcase
components.description: Row of logos + caption. Use for integrations, tech stack, partners, brands. eg. logos=["url1", "url2"], text="caption text".

components.name: LogoWithBrandName
components.description: Logo + brand name reveal. Use for brand intro.

components.name: LogoWithCTA
components.description: Logo icon and brand name reveal with a CTA text below that. Use as the final scene.

components.name: IconShowcase
components.description: Row of icons + caption. Use for integrations, tech stack, partners, brands. eg. icons={["shopify", "midjourney", "openai"]}, text="caption text".

components.name: PillCarousel
components.description: A headline with a carousel of items below, each showing text and an icon (choose an icon name that represents the text) as a pill. Use for features, industries, use cases, capabilities, or categories. ~25 frames per item; minimum 3 items.
